Dual Language Immersion Program

The Dual Language Immersion (DLI) Program helps students develop strong proficiency in both Spanish and English through meaningful, content-based instruction. Centered on LCPS’s commitment to equity, access, and multilingual excellence, the program supports students in becoming bilingual, biliterate, and culturally confident learners.

LCPS launched its first elementary DLI programs at Potowmack and Sanders Corner Elementary Schools in 2023–2024. These schools continue to lead the way in offering engaging, high-quality bilingual learning experiences.

Dual Language Immersion Enrollment Timeline: 

  • Round 1 Offers:  April 20 to 23

  • Round 2 Offers:  April 27 to 30

  • Round 3 Offers:  May 4 to 7

  • Ongoing enrollment will continue as needed and will take place within a Monday-Thursday window.
